about: Real alternatives for Roblox API names that people often assume exist. Read by tools/hooks/premise_check.py. Keys are Class.Member on the class (or an ancestor) the fake is usually written against. `use` lists real Class.Member names (tools/hooks/test_premise_check.py checks each against api-index.json, and checks every fake key still does NOT exist). `note` is one line on how to do it with the real API. Names not listed here still get flagged; this table only makes the suggested alternative better.

EditableImage.Clear.note: fill the whole image with DrawRectangle(Vector2.zero, img.Size, color, 0, Enum.ImageCombineType.Overwrite), or write one pre-filled buffer with WritePixelsBuffer

EditableImage.Fill.note: fill with DrawRectangle over img.Size (Overwrite), or one WritePixelsBuffer of a filled buffer

EditableImage.SetPixel.note: there is no per-pixel setter; write RGBA bytes into a buffer and call WritePixelsBuffer once per frame

EditableImage.GetPixel.note: read a region into a buffer with ReadPixelsBuffer and index it (4 bytes per pixel, RGBA)

EditableMesh.AddQuad.note: a quad is two triangles: AddVertex four times, then AddTriangle(a, b, c) and AddTriangle(a, c, d)

GlobalDataStore.SaveAsync.note: SetAsync(key, value) overwrites; UpdateAsync(key, fn) is the safe read-modify-write for player saves

GlobalDataStore.LoadAsync.note: GetAsync(key) returns the stored value (or nil) plus a DataStoreKeyInfo

Humanoid.SetHealth.note: assign humanoid.Health, or call humanoid:TakeDamage(n) to respect ForceFields

ParticleEmitter.BurstCount.note: a burst is emitter:Emit(count); Rate controls continuous emission

TweenService.Run.note: local tween = TweenService:Create(instance, tweenInfo, goals); tween:Play()

TweenService.Tween.note: local tween = TweenService:Create(instance, tweenInfo, goals); tween:Play()

Instance.Delete.note: instance:Destroy() removes it, disconnects its connections and locks Parent

Instance.GetChildrenOfClass.note: loop GetChildren() and keep child:IsA(className); FindFirstChildOfClass returns only the first

WorldRoot.RaycastDistance.note: local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params); the distance is result.Distance (result is nil on a miss)

Model.SetCFrame.note: model:PivotTo(cframe) moves the whole model by its pivot

Model.SetPosition.note: model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos)) keeps rotation semantics explicit; MoveTo avoids overlaps

WorldRoot.FindPartOnRay.note: workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, RaycastParams) replaces the FindPartOnRay family

WorldRoot.FindPartOnRayWithWhitelist.note: set RaycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include and call workspace:Raycast

Instance.Remove.note: Destroy() instead; Remove only sets Parent to nil and leaks connections
